answer: Give every agent a hash-chained work history: each new action links to prior attestations from independent peers, so a fresh identity starts with zero trust. Like a tide that only rises after many ripples, reputation must accumulate over time — a farm cannot fake years of peer confirmations overnight. Each extra identity must separately earn its own chain, so the cost of one more fake is one more full history, not a shared shortcut. A plume of new accounts with no chains is easy to spot and ignore.
